title: third-party scorer deserialization: metric_name must be a plain identifier and must not appear in kwargs
answers: Why does restoring a RAGAS or DeepEval scorer fail with "metric_name ... must be a plain identifier"?
How do I pass extra constructor arguments such as a threshold to a concrete third-party scorer when it is reloaded?
Where is metric_name validated when a stored third-party scorer is loaded?
body:
Path: Restoring a saved RAGAS, DeepEval or concrete third-party scorer subclass reads the top-level metric_name and the kwargs dict from third_party_scorer_data, in mlflow/genai/scorers/base.py:Scorer.model_validate, before the class is constructed.
Rule: Check `metric_name.isidentifier()` before any import. RagasScorer and DeepEvalScorer splice unknown names into import paths (`ragas.metrics.collections.<name>`, `deepeval.metrics.<name>Metric`), so a dotted or non-identifier name is a second route to a caller-placed module. Also reject any `metric_name` key inside `kwargs` before any import: concrete subclasses pin metric_name as a ClassVar and inherit the wrapper __init__, so the kwarg would override the validated top-level value. Pass other constructor options through kwargs as usual; only the metric_name key is refused.
Symptom: A crafted metric_name, or a metric_name inside kwargs, steered the wrapper's registry lookup so that import_module loaded a module the caller had placed on the server's filesystem.
Constraints: Applies only to third-party scorer payloads. Legitimate payloads are unaffected: a concrete subclass with other kwargs still round-trips, and the top-level metric_name carries the name. Both checks run before import_module, so tests can assert the import is never reached.
applies: Validation of third_party_scorer_data metric_name and kwargs during scorer deserialization in mlflow/genai/scorers; not the built-in scorers or the client-side scorer construction path.
says: Restoring a saved third-party evaluation metric fails because the metric name is invalid.
Saved evaluation scorers fail to load when metric names contain dots or symbols.
Loading a saved evaluation judge fails when metric parameters include the metric name.
Allow custom constructor parameters like score thresholds when reloading saved evaluation judges.
search: During third-party scorer deserialization in mlflow/genai/scorers/base.py:Scorer.model_validate, metric_name must satisfy isidentifier() and must not appear inside kwargs before any import occurs. This prevents crafted dotted metric names or kwargs overrides from steering importlib.import_module toward caller-placed modules in RagasScorer or DeepEvalScorer. Applies strictly to third-party scorer payloads rather than built-in scorers or client-side construction, while other constructor arguments like thresholds in kwargs remain supported.
